messages:
Annika: Heads-up — blocking on kernel->kv handshake. CI canaries pass but we see a 15-20% p99 regression under continuous-batching workloads. Need unblock plan.

Devin: Ack. I saw the same in perf run this morning. Looks like KV eviction and the new microbatch path are interacting.

Raj: @Devin can you drop the exact command you used so I can reproduce locally?

Devin: sure — run locally:```./scripts/bench --scenario continuous-batch --branch feat/kernel-kv-evict --seq 2048 --concurrency 16```

Sophie: quick summary from infra side — the platform's autoscaler bumped pods and that amplified cold-KV hits. If we reduce prefetch window by half the p99 improves but throughput dips. Tradeoff.

Annika: We need a decision: prefer lower p99 or keep throughput for the canary? Current canary blocked until we have an owner + mitigation.

Raj: I can own a short-term mitigation: add a small warmup before accepting traffic and tune kv_eviction_threshold for the canary. Will raise a PR.

Devin: Thanks. For the PR ping: @Raj please include these three things in the description — 1) bench command + baseline numbers, 2) config delta for kv_eviction_threshold, 3) rollback steps (how to revert warmup).

Sophie: Also add an env flag to gate warmup so ops can toggle without redeploy. That avoids full rollback.

Annika: Ownership: Raj = mitigation PR, Devin = perf verification + logs, Sophie = ops toggle + rollout plan. ETA for PR?

Raj: I'll cut the PR today, aim for EOD PST. If reviewers are free, request quick review from @Devin and @Sophie.

Devin: I'll run the bench once PR is up and post results here. If stable, we can unblock the canary.

buildbot: deploy-bot: Canaries paused on cluster "us-west1" due to blocking thread 1791112223. Reply "unpause" after mitigation merged.

Annika: Note dependencies — eng-platform needs to merge the autoscaler tweak (ticket PLAT-823). @Sophie can you link that once you confirm toggle works?

Sophie: Yep. I'll coordinate with platform. If warmup flag looks good, I'll open a follow-on with PLAT-823 cross-ref.

Raj: PR: https://git.redwood.internal/r/runtime/pulls/842 — draft in progress. Adding bench outputs and env flag.

Devin: Reproduced locally with your branch + warmup disabled: p99 +18%. With warmup enabled + kv_eviction_threshold=0.75: p99 back to +3% baseline. Attaching short table in PR.

Annika: Good progress. Next steps: merge once Sophie confirms ops toggle; then unblock canary. Keep this thread for rollout updates; ping if you hit review blockers. :thumbsup:

Sophie: I'll validate the toggle in staging by 14:00 PST and update PLAT-823. If green, I'll say "unpause" to buildbot.

Raj: Thanks — will address review comments quickly.

Devin: FYI I'll also run a longer 4h stability run overnight after merge to catch any tail regressions.

Annika: Great. If anyone needs extra reviewer bandwidth, @Devin has a +1 from infra to prioritize.

buildbot: deploy-bot: reminder scheduled — canaries will remain paused until explicit "unpause" command in this thread.

Sophie: staging toggle validated — warmup flag flips cleanly, no infra churn. Posted link to PLAT-823 in PR.

Annika: Merge window when ready. Make sure PR includes the rollback steps.

Raj: Merged. Tagging: @Devin please run your 4h test.

Devin: Starting 4h stability run now. I'll post final numbers in ~4h.

buildbot: deploy-bot: unpause command received from Sophie. Resuming canary deploys in us-west1.

Sophie: unpause

Annika: Thanks team — will close the loop after Devin's run. If we stay within +5% p99, we consider this unblocked and will move to ramp.

Devin: 4h run finished. p99 averaged +2.8%, throughput stable. No new errors. Recommend ramp to 25% traffic.

Annika: Approved. Ramp to 25% and monitor. I'll set a 2h checkpoint to re-evaluate.

Sophie: ramping to 25% now. I'll watch dashboards and alert on p99 spikes.

Raj: thanks all — marking my tasks done in the sprint ticket.

Annika: Closing thread in 2h if no regressions. Appreciate the quick turnaround. :tada:
